name: School Love! ~Soyokaze no Harmony~
original_name: すくぅ～る・らぶっ！～そよ風のハーモニー～
source:
Over a period of one month, you attempt to both discover your life goal and get some Love Love going with one of the game's busty anime chicks.

[From [url=http://ps2.ign.com/articles/725/725310p1.html]an article at IGN.com[/url]]
translation:
在一个月的时间里，你要寻找人生目标，并与游戏中某位身材丰满的动画女孩发展甜蜜恋爱。

[摘自[url=http://ps2.ign.com/articles/725/725310p1.html]IGN.com的文章[/url]]
